correctness.rationale: Normalized cubic Gegenbauer addition kernel Q3(u)=((n+1)u³−3u)/(n−2) yields a degree-three polynomial of |S∩T|. The subset-incidence diagonalization gives four factored rational eigenvalues and explicit sector multiplicities. Their zeros are exactly antipodal even sectors on n=2k and a first-degree sector when n(n+1)=6k(n−k), equivalent to the complete positive Pell family. The checker reconstructs nine Gram matrices, verifies all four formulas symbolically, and confirms four Pell cases; finite numerics are not used as a proof of the unbounded theorem.
